text: DEWALT is one of Stanley Black & Decker's priority global brands in its Tools & Outdoor segment.
short: DEWALT is a Stanley Black & Decker brand.

source.name: Stanley Black & Decker, Inc. – Form 10-K for fiscal 2025 (SEC)
source.quote: The Company’s priority global brands within the Tools & Outdoor segment include DEWALT®, CRAFTSMAN®, and STANLEY®, supported by a broader portfolio of complementary brands.
